summary: This note covers the song "Whiskey River," co-written and recorded by American country singer Johnny Bush. Bush released it in 1972 through RCA Victor on his album of the same name. He later re-recorded it in 1981 for the Delta label, backed with "When My Conscience Hurts the Most" on the B-side.
one_line: Johnny Bush's country song "Whiskey River", released in 1972 and re-recorded in 1981.
key_facts: "Whiskey River" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music singer Johnny Bush.
Johnny Bush released "Whiskey River" in 1972 through RCA Victor.
Johnny Bush included "Whiskey River" on his album also titled "Whiskey River".
The 1981 version of "Whiskey River" was released through the Delta label.
The 1981 release of "Whiskey River" had "When My Conscience Hurts the Most" on the b-side.
